tasks.label: svc-ai-agent: scale down pod
tasks.command: kubectl -n aura scale deploy/svc-ai-agent --replicas=0 && kubectl -n aura rollout status deploy/svc-ai-agent --timeout=60s

tasks.label: svc-ai-agent: scale up pod
tasks.command: kubectl -n aura scale deploy/svc-ai-agent --replicas=1 && kubectl -n aura rollout status deploy/svc-ai-agent --timeout=90s
